submission.justification: Crystal-K1 has the best resolution at 662 keV (2.9% FWHM), but its intrinsic background is 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day, four times the facility's 0.5 counts/kg/day budget. That background comes from contamination inside the crystal itself, so shielding cannot remove it, and K1 fails the low-background constraint. Of the two crystals within budget, K2 has much better resolution than K3 (4.5% vs 8.5% FWHM), with a background of 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day. I chose 5 cm because it is the thickness the 2025 simulation was run at, and it falls inside the 2-10 cm limit. That simulation found resolution changes little with thickness between 3 and 8 cm. No simulation tool was available, so I did not run a new thickness optimisation. The resolution figures come only from the 2025 summary.

requirements.evidence: K2 has 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm (2025 simulation summary). That is the best of the crystals that meet the background budget; K3 is 8.5%. K1 (2.9%) is excluded on background.
